cards.example_en: Flour is the main substance in this simple bread.
cards.example_zh: 面粉是这种简单面包里的主要物质。

cards.example_en: We made a substantial donation of books to the library.
cards.example_zh: 我们向图书馆捐赠了大量图书。

cards.example_en: They live in a quiet suburb.
cards.example_zh: 他们住在安静的郊区。

cards.example_en: Take the subway to the museum.
cards.example_zh: 坐地铁去博物馆。

cards.example_en: The successful experiment produced a bright blue liquid.
cards.example_zh: 这次成功的实验做出了一种亮蓝色液体。

cards.example_en: We have sufficient food for a week.
cards.example_zh: 我们有足够的食物吃一周。

cards.example_en: My suggestion was to start the meeting earlier.
cards.example_zh: 我的提议是把会议提前开始。

cards.example_en: This film isn't suitable for young children.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影不适合年幼的儿童。

cards.example_en: Check the sum before you pay the restaurant bill.
cards.example_zh: 付餐馆账单之前，先把总和核对一遍。

cards.example_en: Our summary of the chapter filled half a page.
cards.example_zh: 我们对这一章写的摘要占了半页纸。

cards.example_en: That was a super performance.
cards.example_zh: 那是一场极好的演出。

cards.example_en: The superb meal at Grandma's house needed no extra salt.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶家那顿极好的饭菜完全不用再加盐。

cards.example_en: This plan is superior to the old one.
cards.example_zh: 这个计划比旧的更好。

cards.example_en: Ships supply fresh water to the island school each week.
cards.example_zh: 船只每周给岛上的学校补给淡水。

cards.example_en: They surf when the waves are high.
cards.example_zh: 浪大的时候他们去冲浪。

cards.example_en: The surgeon finished the operation.
cards.example_zh: 外科医生做完了手术。

cards.example_en: Minor surgery on his wrist kept him at home for days.
cards.example_zh: 手腕上的一个小手术让他在家待了好几天。

cards.example_en: Trees surround the small lake.
cards.example_zh: 树木环绕着小湖。

cards.example_en: We explored the surrounding villages.
cards.example_zh: 我们探访了周围的村庄。

cards.example_en: I suspect the window was left open.
cards.example_zh: 我怀疑窗户没关。

cards.example_en: The school will suspend the match.
cards.example_zh: 学校将暂停这场比赛。

cards.example_en: Trees sustain many kinds of life.
cards.example_zh: 树木维持着多种生命。

cards.example_en: Sweat ran down his face.
cards.example_zh: 汗从他脸上淌下。

cards.example_en: Swimming before breakfast wakes me up completely.
cards.example_zh: 早饭前游泳能让我完全清醒过来。

cards.example_en: The children swing in the park.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们在公园里荡秋千。

cards.example_en: Some families switch from driving to cycling this month.
cards.example_zh: 这个月有些家庭从开车转变为骑自行车。

cards.example_en: She showed sympathy for the injured player.
cards.example_zh: 她对受伤的队员表示同情。

cards.example_en: We listened to a symphony.
cards.example_zh: 我们听了一首交响乐。

cards.example_en: Our heating system rattles whenever the wind rises.
cards.example_zh: 风一大，我们的供暖系统就咔咔作响。

cards.example_en: Take one tablet with water after you eat breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 吃完早饭后，用水送服一片药片。

cards.example_en: The council must tackle the litter problem near the shops.
cards.example_zh: 市政部门必须处理商店附近的垃圾问题。

cards.example_en: The tailor shortened his trousers.
cards.example_zh: 裁缝把他的裤子改短了。

cards.example_en: Dad's tale about a brave mouse lasted until bedtime.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸讲的勇敢小老鼠的故事一直讲到睡觉。

cards.example_en: Mud covered the tank as it crossed the empty field.
cards.example_zh: 坦克穿过空地时，身上沾满了泥。

cards.example_en: Beating our old score is the target for Friday.
cards.example_zh: 超过我们以前的分数，是星期五的目标。

cards.example_en: The tax added two pounds to the price of the coat.
cards.example_zh: 加上税费以后，这件外套的价格多了两英镑。

cards.example_en: The teapot is full of hot tea.
cards.example_zh: 茶壶里装满了热茶。

cards.example_en: A tear rolled down her cheek.
cards.example_zh: 一滴眼泪从她脸颊滚落。

cards.example_en: Her serving technique improved after weeks of practice.
cards.example_zh: 练了几个星期之后，她的发球手法进步了。

cards.example_en: The club is for every teenager at school.
cards.example_zh: 这个社团面向学校里的每一位青少年。

cards.example_en: The office telephone rang all through lunch break.
cards.example_zh: 办公室的电话响了整整一个午休。

cards.example_en: We looked at the moon through a telescope.
cards.example_zh: 我们用望远镜看月亮。

cards.example_en: We argued about the film we saw on television.
cards.example_zh: 我们就在电视上看到的那部电影争论了起来。

cards.example_en: The old temple is on the hill.
cards.example_zh: 古老的寺庙在山上。

cards.example_en: The school built a temporary classroom after the storm.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，学校搭了一间临时教室。

cards.example_en: I tend to forget my water bottle on Mondays.
cards.example_zh: 每到星期一，我往往会忘记带水瓶。

cards.example_en: There is a tendency to stay up too late.
cards.example_zh: 有熬夜过晚的趋势。

cards.example_en: You could feel the tension while the scores were read.
cards.example_zh: 宣读分数的时候，你能感到那种紧张。

cards.example_en: Wolves mark territory so other packs stay away.
cards.example_zh: 狼会标记领土，让别的狼群不敢靠近。

cards.example_en: The police investigated the theft.
cards.example_zh: 警察调查了这起盗窃。

word.example_en: The hall is suitable for a concert.
word.example_zh: 这个大厅适宜于开音乐会。
